from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
im=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
R,G,B=im.T
# candidate yellow
for name,m in {
 'yellow':(R>120)&(G>80)&(B<90)&(R>G*1.05)&(G>B*1.25),
 'dark':(R<55)&(G<55)&(B<55),
 'gray':(abs(R-G)<12)&(abs(G-B)<12)&(R>50)&(R<190),
 'wood':(R>70)&(G>45)&(B<80)&(R>G),
}.items():
    lab,n=ndimage.label(m.T)
    objs=ndimage.find_objects(lab)
    comps=[]
    for i,s in enumerate(objs,1):
      if s is None: continue
      area=(lab[s]==i).sum()
      if area>10: comps.append((area,(s[1].start,s[0].start,s[1].stop,s[0].stop)))
    print('\\n',name,'pixels',m.sum(),'components',sorted(comps, reverse=True)[:20])
# ascii at full res in blocks 4x4 based category
chars=np.full((36,64),' ',dtype='<U1')
for by,y in enumerate(range(0,144,4)):
 for bx,x in enumerate(range(0,256,4)):
  p=im[y:y+4,x:x+4].mean((0,1)); r,g,b=p
  if r>120 and g>80 and b<90 and r>g: c='Y'
  elif r<55 and g<55 and b<55: c='#'
  elif abs(r-g)<12 and abs(g-b)<12 and r>45: c='o'
  elif r>g>b and r>70: c='.'
  else: c='-'
  chars[by,bx]=c
print('\\n'.join(''.join(row) for row in chars))
PY"
